text:
SSL::clientrandom
Description
This iRules command returns the ClientRandom value from the Client
hello.
Syntax
SSL
::
clientrandom
Examples
when
CLIENTSSL_HANDSHAKE
{
log
local0.info
"negotiated protocol: [SSL::clientrandom]"
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
ANY
